backup_scope: 0x000000..0x07ffff only; all sectors changed by app update are included. Rest of flash is unchanged.
prior_temporary_app: Rev A/B build loaded based on saved order; replaced before inspecting readings
firmware_active: Standard Rev D release restored after resume diagnostics; app hash verified
final_state: FINISH_CAL; calibration required before voltage measurement
initial_adc_fault_cause: Unconfirmed; not reproduced in diagnostic or final standard-firmware recheck

usb_power_rail_checks.precision: Approximate; no additional digits or meter accuracy supplied

zero_calibration_status: ZERO_SAVED; this assumes all twelve terminals were open
calibration_phase: Guided local UI: new calibration pass starting at input 1; existing gains retained until replaced
pending_low_point_storage: ESP32 RAM only; keep USB and the current serial console connected
external_known_voltage_test_scope: Input 1 high calibration point only; no independent post-calibration measurement or pair test yet

input_1_reference_measurement.source: User-reported readings; multimeter used for calibration
